top_signals.title: At Nonna Nietta, Italian magic in suburban Tsukuba
top_signals.summary: Chef Kenji Kawamura spent six formative years training as a chef in Italy. That dedication shows in the deep, authentic flavors up and down the menu at his Ibaraki restaurant.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
